scenes.title: The chat is over
scenes.viewerPurpose: Your AI finished the chat, but did it finish the work?
scenes.composition: An illustrated chat ends while an unfinished document remains beside it.
addOrChange: Create simple original workspace illustration; use four selected story scenes through the shared book compiler rather than the old AssistOS tutorial renderer.

cues.visualAction: Close the finished conversation, leaving the visible unfinished document in place.
Reveal a shared workspace containing the document, a person and one clearly nonhuman software worker.

scenes.title: The work continues
scenes.viewerPurpose: A document needs revising, a piece of research needs checking, or a code change needs review.
scenes.composition: One project folder contains a document, a research note and a code change.
addOrChange: Add stable project, document, research-note and code-change assets with consistent IDs; no fake live product screenshot.

cues.visualAction: Bring the three unfinished items into the same project folder with short readable labels.
Return to the folder after a brief transition; keep the previous decision attached to the document.

scenes.title: Stay in control
scenes.viewerPurpose: The book asks how conversation, useful tools, and shared projects could fit together.
scenes.composition: The person follows a visible task record and can pause the proposed change.
addOrChange: Add task record, tool and pause control; keep human permission visible and do not show autonomous approval.

cues.visualAction: Connect one conversation request to a tool and its resulting project file.
A hand selects Pause before execution; reveal the proposed file change for inspection.

scenes.title: Bring the project with you
scenes.viewerPurpose: It also examines what must survive when a model or service is replaced.
scenes.composition: The project remains while one interchangeable model component changes.
addOrChange: Add two neutral model components and a stable history record; avoid logos or unsupported compatibility promises.

cues.visualAction: Exchange the small model component while leaving files and decision history in place.
Finish on the continuing project beside the book, with one unfinished task ready for the next visit.

checks: Do not generate voice until all122 script and visual plans pass review.
Use only source-grounded diagrams and neutral illustrative examples; preserve uncertainty and proposal labels.
Measure audio and keep the complete film at or below120 seconds without accelerating narration.
Inspect Color, Light and Dark at desktop and phone sizes; verify captions, labels and cue timing.
Listening review and visual QA are separate from having a compiled film.
